scientific limitations/integrity: The theorem is local at \(\lambda_0=4\sqrt3\pi\) and is proved separately for each fixed finite \(N\ge1\). It does not assert convergence of the formal infinite branch, an actual Barker--Larman counterexample, or a second-order coefficient. The proof is analytic; the packaged symbolic computation only replays the first-variation algebra. MSC \(52A20\) is consistent with the established classification of the Barker--Larman convex-body determination problem and adjacent false-centre work.
title: Exact first-order non-sphericity of Haddad's Barker--Larman branch
